noexceptInvestigation.status: Confirmed valid positive failure; unchanged expectations
noexceptInvestigation.diagnosis: noexcept(expression) parsed as undeclared function; lambda noexcept discarded, conditional specification unsupported
noexceptInvestigation.experiment: Bare lambda noexcept propagation alone did not repair regression; reverted and republished through build gate
noexceptInvestigation.remaining: Implement semantic potentially-throwing analysis for unevaluated expressions, lambda call specifications and conversion function types

noexceptCheckpoint.implementation: Semantic noexcept query tracks selected calls at the operand evaluation depth, excludes nested unevaluated operands and inference probes, handles throw, temporary cleanup, deletion, array allocation and RTTI checks. Lambda exception specifications preserved including conditional generic replay, concrete parameter scope and captureless function-pointer conversion types. Member-template exception-specification replay receives parameter scope.
noexceptCheckpoint.remaining: Complete C++17 conformance remains unproven. Further noexcept auditing includes implicit/defaulted special members, operator/conversion routes, substitution recovery, generic lambda conversions and allocation variants. Other language and library gaps remain in task.md.
